probe.snapshotNormalization: Replaced the synthetic data URL with a placeholder; remaining accessibility text is tool output.
findings: Outer host grid-column:span 2 spans 210px; setting that property on the inner part leaves the host at 100px in the same grid.
A native h2 inside the shadow root exposes heading level 2 with slotted visible text.
Host-only aria-label names a separate generic node and does not rename the inner heading; copying the label to both creates two named AX nodes.
Inner aria-labelledby string cannot resolve the outside external-name ID; ariaLabelledByElements resolves the parent-scope element and yields a region named External title.
document.querySelectorAll(h1...h6) returns zero for the three shadow headings; TOC discovery needs an explicit house-heading contract.
These are synthetic Chromium results, not production components, actual screen-reader speech or three-engine certification.
probe.scope: Native HTML with declarative shadow roots and one element-reference assignment; no production component or Lit/React/state integration

sourceFindings: Material Web delegate.ts/aria.ts read in full at 56a486b147b8b7e95e6e8035fa02aed7e0009a85. It shifts supported scalar ARIA attributes into data attributes, overrides attribute/property access, and explicitly lacks IDREF support.
Do not copy Material's dataset state or DOM-method overrides as an approved mechanism; house TanStack state and interface invariants still apply.
MDN documents same-tree scope for string ID attributes and same-or-parent scope for reflected element references; the earlier living-analysis wording must distinguish them.
Pro lexical search of all indexed JSX/TSX files found no literal aria-labelledby or aria-describedby; this does not establish no library-generated relationships.

Pro AST scan of literal Box as attributes found structural header/nav/footer/aside/main uses plus form/list/table/text/custom-component substitutions; these are source examples, not automatically approved Lit tag capabilities. No direct literal Box as=span was found.
Radix Box API supports div/span; Text API supports span/div/label/p. The house selections retain its separately chosen defaults and component responsibilities.
